notes.title: V0.9.5.2 Shura Mode + Steam Global Ranking!!
notes.content:
The standard mode has added [b] Shura [/b] difficulty, and this difficulty record will be included in the [b] Steam Global Player Ranking [/b]!! Welcome all heroes to come and challenge, experience deeper gameplay strategies, and feel more exciting battles.

[b]The rules of Shura mode are as follows:[/b]
1. Random character winning streak challenge. In this mode, players cannot choose their own characters and need to be proficient in the gameplay style of the initial 8 characters.

2. After 250 steps in each level, players will continue to suffer fatigue damage (-1/-2/-3...), which ignores armor.

4.The winning streak under this difficulty level will be included in the Steam Global Player Ranking, ranking in the top 100.

5.Based on rules and difficult modes.

[b] Shura difficulty unlocking conditions: [/b]
Unlock the initial 8 characters and use any character to complete the difficult mode once

[Lost Book]: Art images have been updated, and the guaranteed drop probability for difficult or higher difficulty levels has been reduced.

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
In some cases, the direction of the attack animation is abnormal.

notes.title: V0.9.2.5 Update Announcement - Ye Kai/Xiao Yao Enhanced
notes.content:
First of all, thank you to all the players for your support. Although the game's popularity is not high and sales have not met expectations (mainly due to issues with the art style and user experience), our game continues to receive positive reviews. We will continue to update the content for everyone and make the game better and better! We will also address the issue of art style by adding new skins and modifying some old standing paintings. Please rest assured!!!

In addition, the official update roadmap for the V1.0 version of the game has been displayed on the game store page~!

The first major patch of  VineCard one week after its launch is as follows:


1. Balance adjustment.

Ye Kai has added a new skill [example not false]:

When equipped with the Fallen Leaf Flying Blade, if no attack is made, the weapon's attack power will increase by 1 at the end of the turn.

[img]https://clan.st.dl.eccdnx.com/images/44706776/de329fc9acd68ff5a2351f99cfac00fabaa0111b.png[/img]

Explanation: When we initially designed the character Ye Kai, we intended to make it a rhythmic and consumptive character because the reference character prototype was Comrade Ye Kai from Gu Long's novel. Compared to Li Xunhuan, his flying sword was more casual and unrestrained, but not as deadly. Therefore, we gave the character a certain level of damage growth and explosive ability. But the data feedback within a week shows that the character's current strength is weak, mainly due to weak growth in the later stage,

We have decided to add back the skills that were initially discarded, such as' not inflated ', allowing players to achieve high explosive levels in the later stages through positional strategies.

Xiao Yao - Little Beggar Skill [My Cloth Clothes] Adjustment

At the end of each round, all armor will be converted into attack power and will become ineffective after the next attack.

[img]https://clan.st.dl.eccdnx.com/images/44706776/45ea7addc59a7745865437dfe112a56968fdd784.png[/img]

Original effect:

At the end of each round, all armor will be converted into attack power and will become ineffective after the next action.

explain:

We have noticed that the beggar is the character with the lowest clearance rate, and the core issue is that it is difficult to control the burst time of my cloth clothes. We have decided to strengthen this skill to allow players to more easily deal explosive damage. After all, this character's growth is slow, the output range is small, and resources are all hit one stick at a time, requiring a strong post burst.

2. New station options [Fengmang Casting]

Effect: Increases the attack power of the current weapon by 6 points

[img]https://clan.st.dl.eccdnx.com/images/44706776/a32a9de552bf5dd175cc27d5bb82171726744efb.jpg[/img]

Explanation: After adding 'Immortal Casting' in the previous version, we found that this type of skill has a qualitative improvement on many weapons, such as' Golden Bell Shield ',' Gatling ',' Salted Fish Stick ', etc. Although the options for station weapons are usually not the first choice for players (mainly because players are not good at utilizing weapon resources during the early stages), we have decided to add some powerful skills to the weapon buff genre.


3 new difficulty levels - Shura mode (added to the Steam leaderboard) is expected to debut in the next version, welcome all kinds of experts to challenge!

The rules are as follows:

【1】 Random character winning streak challenge

【2】 Based on the difficulty of the difficult mode, but suffered fatigue damage after 250 steps

【3】 Join the Steam global player's highest winning streak ranking

notes.title: Strategy Roguelike Game "Vine Card" Launches Early Access
notes.content:
[i]Vine Card[/i] is a card-based strategy game that combines tactical grid-based gameplay with light roguelike elements. 

Our brand-new PV is now live, and the game will be released on August 8th for an original price of $9.99, with a launch discount price of $8.99 Join us on this adventurous journey through the martial arts world!

Explore legendary weapons in this world, slay demons, solve intricate puzzles, and train to reach the pinnacle of martial arts. Choose your favorite character and advance carefully on the fictional battlefield grid. Plan your route wisely, collect gold, pick up weapons or items, and face off against enemies and bosses stationed at various strongholds.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2649800/

[previewyoutube=iLrU6-YiUTo;full][/previewyoutube]

Features: 
[list]
[*] A fusion of Eastern and Western cultures with dozens of weapons and martial arts techniques.
[*] Eight distinct protagonists, allowing for flexible strategy combinations.
[*] Easy-to-learn but hard-to-master grid-based and roguelike strategy.
[*] Encounter legendary figures from various cultures, such as King Arthur and Dracula.
[/list]

notes.title: Humorous Wuxia Card Strategy Game 'VINECARD' Joins the Steam Next Fest,
notes.content:
'VINECARD' is a card strategy game that combines turn-based tactics with light roguelike elements. Explore the Ziwei Star for divine weapons, defeat demons, solve intricate puzzles, and train to reach the pinnacle of your abilities. Choose your favorite character and advance carefully on the fictional battlefield grid. Plan your route wisely, collect gold, pick up weapons or items, and face off against enemies and bosses stationed at various points.

We are participating in the Steam June Next Fest, with a new trailer and a free demo now available. We invite everyone to experience the game and add it to your wishlist!

The demo features two playable characters. We hope everyone can try it out, and feel free to provide any feedback or questions in the Steam community.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2649800/_Vinecard/

Game Features:
[list]
[*] Dozens of weapons and martial arts techniques inspired by Chinese Wuxia culture
[*] Eight distinct protagonists, allowing for free combination of different play styles
[*] Easy to learn, hard to master combination of grid-based tactics and card roguelike gameplay
[*] Visit famous historical sites, such as Mawei Slope and Sanxingdui

notes.title: Humorous Wuxia Card Strategy Game 'VINECARD' Joins the Steam Next Fest,
notes.content:
'VINECARD' is a card strategy game that combines turn-based tactics with light roguelike elements. Explore the Ziwei Star for divine weapons, defeat demons, solve intricate puzzles, and train to reach the pinnacle of your abilities. Choose your favorite character and advance carefully on the fictional battlefield grid. Plan your route wisely, collect gold, pick up weapons or items, and face off against enemies and bosses stationed at various points.

We are participating in the Steam June Next Fest, with a new trailer and a free demo now available. We invite everyone to experience the game and add it to your wishlist!

The demo features two playable characters. We hope everyone can try it out, and feel free to provide any feedback or questions in the Steam community.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2649800/_Vinecard/

Game Features:
[list]
[*] Dozens of weapons and martial arts techniques inspired by Chinese Wuxia culture
[*] Eight distinct protagonists, allowing for free combination of different play styles
[*] Easy to learn, hard to master combination of grid-based tactics and card roguelike gameplay
[*] Visit famous historical sites, such as Mawei Slope and Sanxingdui
[/list]
